title: Auto Attack And More

🔹 Bring Monsters: Tired of searching for monsters to battle? Our Script has you covered. With a simple command, you can summon monsters to your location, ensuring that you're always engaged in thrilling battles and reaping the rewards.

🔹 Upgrade Damage: Maximize your strength and become unstoppable! Our Script assists you in upgrading your damage, empowering your attacks and making you a formidable force. Crush your enemies and conquer the darkest corners of the realm!

🔹 And More: Our Script is filled with additional features to enrich your gameplay. From resource management to cooldown reduction, we've got you covered. Unleash your full potential and overcome any challenge that comes your way!
